description: VERUS_SQL_COVERAGE task C: integrity constraints. A constraint-valid instance of constraints/cov_c_schema.sql (composite PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE with NULLs and NULLS NOT DISTINCT, composite FKs MATCH SIMPLE / FULL with a permuted mapping, self FK, cross-type FKs, CHECK True/Unknown incl. integer division and CASE). Violating instances are in ../constraints/cov_c_violations/ (PostgreSQL cannot load them).

cases.name: c_pk2
cases.sql: SELECT a, b, v FROM pk2
cases.note: Composite PRIMARY KEY (a, b): distinct pairs, a repeated alone.

cases.name: c_uq_nulls
cases.sql: SELECT id, x, y FROM uq
cases.note: UNIQUE (x, y) NULLS DISTINCT: (1, NULL) twice and (NULL, NULL) twice are accepted.

cases.name: c_uqn
cases.sql: SELECT id, x, y FROM uqn
cases.note: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT: (1, NULL), (2, NULL), (NULL, NULL) are distinct tuples.

cases.name: c_fk_simple_join
cases.sql: SELECT f.id, p.v FROM fks f JOIN pk2 p ON f.x = p.a AND f.y = p.b
cases.note: Composite FK MATCH SIMPLE: (9, NULL) and (NULL, NULL) are exempt and join nothing.

cases.name: c_fk_full_permuted
cases.sql: SELECT f.id, p.v FROM fkf f JOIN pk2 p ON f.y = p.b AND f.x = p.a
cases.note: MATCH FULL FK (y, x) -> pk2 (b, a) (column mapping permuted); all-NULL row exempt.

cases.name: c_check_rows
cases.sql: SELECT id, a, b, c FROM ck
cases.note: CHECK True everywhere or Unknown (row 2: a, b, c NULL): accepted.

cases.name: c_self_fk
cases.sql: SELECT e.id, b.id AS boss FROM emp e LEFT JOIN emp b ON e.boss = b.id
cases.note: Self-referencing FK (DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED metadata); row 3 references itself.

cases.name: c_fk_int8_numeric
cases.sql: SELECT n.id, p.k FROM fkn n JOIN pkn p ON n.k = p.k
cases.note: bigint FK referencing numeric(6,2) key: value equality 1 = 1.00.

cases.name: c_fk_bpchar_varchar
cases.note: char(5) FK referencing varchar(5): PostgreSQL casts with rtrim, i.e. the canonical stored char value.

cases.name: c_fk_timestamp_date
cases.note: timestamp FK referencing a date key: midnight equals the date.

cases.name: c_check_capacity_row
cases.note: CHECK with a 10-fold product; 1.00 stays in the executable domain.
